column1: # Tape parsers PSTORE/PLOAD/PIMM/PMOV/PTHREE and register rewrite REREG.
# EOF = 256; register operands are r followed by one or more decimal digits.
# PSTORE: store64 slot span and source register; st_x remains -1 on failure.
# PLOAD: load64 destination and slot span; the closing bracket must end the line.
# PIMM: an unsigned decimal immediate of 1..18 digits, accumulated with 64-bit actions.
# PMOV: two registers, comma then one non-newline byte before the source register.
# PTHREE: skip opcode, then parse three registers with the same separators.
# REREG: replace the selected register among the first token or all tokens.
